== Build notes ==
The Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil publication was checked against [[:File:Reflections-II-Foil-L-Z-95-Headhunter-SWCA-photo-68119-original.jpg|the original physical foil photograph]] from Duncan Jenkins, Star Wars Collectors Archive. The original JPEG and provenance are retained on the File page. Printed wording, symbols and statistics were read from this face independently of earlier printings. Publication identity is separate from any playable mapping.

The foil prints “Hyperdrive No hyperdrive” as the speed label. That printed label is retained separately in the infobox.
